description: Arrêts, horaires et circuits Impulsyon à La Roche-sur-Yon (GTFS) is a dataset listed in Open Data La Roche-sur-Yon, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Impulsyon. Arrêts, horaires et circuits du réseau de transport Impulsyon au format GTFS à La Roche-sur-Yon. Retrouvez également ces données sur le Point d’Accès National aux données de transport (transport.data.gouv.fr). Coverage: La Roche-sur-Yon Agglomération (Vendée). The portal files it under Mobilité. Its keywords are transports, mobilité, lignes, arrêts, horaires, impulsyon. The portal shows 9 records. The portal shows 2026-08-23 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODbL-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-larochesuryon-fr-portal.
